subject.title: fix(slack): respect group DM sender allowlists [AI]

question: Should Slack MPDM ingress fail closed to explicit stable Slack user IDs in `channels.slack.allowFrom`, excluding wildcard, pairing-store, mutable-name, and channel-member fallback authorization for MPDM senders?
rationale: The patch tightens a Slack sender authorization boundary but intentionally narrows existing MPDM behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before accepting the compatibility impact.

options.title: Accept Explicit-ID MPDM Gate After Proof
options.body: Require redacted live Slack MPDM allow/deny proof, then accept explicit Slack user IDs as the intended MPDM sender authorization boundary.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility By Default
options.body: Keep wildcard or fallback MPDM behavior for existing setups and require a separate strict mode or migration plan before fail-closing MPDMs.

options.title: Pause For Broader Slack Auth Design
options.body: Hold this PR until MPDM docs, operator migration, and adjacent Slack interaction behavior can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit-ID MPDM Gate After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted live Slack MPDM allow/deny proof, then accept explicit Slack user IDs as the intended MPDM sender authorization boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current history signal for the shared Slack ingress resolver and central channel-ingress boundary affected by the decision.
